A woman living before Israel's Monarchy, only mentioned at Jdg.4.4; married to Deborah (H1683H) 
§ Lapidoth = "torches"
the husband of Deborah the prophetess in the time of the judges

before, to the face of
A grammatical form of pa.neh (פָּנֶה ": face" H6440)

1) to twist, grasp, turn, grasp with a twisting motion
1a) (Qal) to grasp
1b) (Niphal) to twist, weave, wind
scorning, bragging

(Qal) to scorn, make mouths at, talk arrogantly
Another spelling of luts (לִיץ "to mock" H3887)
